evals.prompt: 현재 feature 브랜치를 최신 origin/main 위로 업데이트해줘. working tree는 clean이고 main에 새 커밋 3개가 있어.
evals.expected_output: The response fetches remote truth and rebases the branch onto origin/main.
expectations: It uses the fetched origin/main as the base.
It preserves linear history through rebase rather than a merge commit.
It confirms the resulting base relationship and summarizes incoming commits.

evals.prompt: main 최신화해줘. 그런데 아직 커밋하지 않은 src/cart.ts와 새 파일 notes.txt가 있어.
evals.expected_output: The response preserves the dirty worktree and does not silently mutate or package those changes.
expectations: It identifies the dirty files before rewriting history.
It does not commit, stash, or discard them without authority.
It leaves the local state intact and reports why the update cannot safely complete.

evals.prompt: pull main 해줘. fetch해보니 HEAD가 이미 origin/main을 포함하고 있어.
evals.expected_output: The response reports that the checkout is already current without rewriting it.
expectations: It fetches or otherwise verifies current remote truth.
It performs no unnecessary history rewrite.
It reports the up-to-date result clearly.

evals.prompt: origin/main에 리베이스해줘. 충돌은 생성된 lockfile뿐이고 package manifest의 의도는 명확해.
evals.expected_output: The response resolves the mechanical conflict from established project evidence and completes the rebase.
expectations: It derives the lockfile result from the authoritative manifest rather than guessing.
It completes the rebase when the intended result is provable.
It verifies that local work remains represented.

evals.prompt: main을 당겨줘. 결제 정책 코드에서 양쪽 브랜치가 서로 다른 수수료 규칙을 추가해서 충돌해.
evals.expected_output: The response preserves recoverability and asks for the unresolved product intent instead of inventing a policy.
expectations: It recognizes that the conflict requires product intent.
It keeps the original work recoverable.
It reports the conflicting files and asks only for the policy decision needed to continue.

evals.prompt: detached worktree의 현재 커밋을 최신 main 기준으로 맞춰줘. 로컬 커밋은 잃으면 안 돼.
evals.expected_output: The response safely rebases the detached checkout or establishes an equivalent recoverable branch before updating.
expectations: It recognizes the detached checkout.
It preserves a recoverable reference to the local commits.
It reaches a state based on fetched origin/main without losing work.

evals.prompt: 이 저장소의 remote default branch는 origin/trunk야. 브랜치 이름을 따로 지정하지 않았으니 기본 브랜치 최신 변경에 맞춰줘.
evals.expected_output: The response resolves origin/trunk as the advertised remote default and rebases onto it.
expectations: It resolves the remote default branch rather than assuming main.
It fetches and rebases onto origin/trunk.
It reports the resolved remote and base branch.
